summary.zh: 把知识内容改编成多格教育漫画

description.zh: 根据主题生成原创教育漫画，支持多种画风和语气，分镜版式可细致调整。适合科普、人物小传和教程类内容。生成画面需要可用的图像生成后端。
description.en: Builds original educational comics with configurable art styles, tone and panel layout. Fits science explainers, short biographies and tutorial series. Image generation requires an available backend.
